packageRules.description: Keep Maven Resolver on 1.x: 2.x drops transport-http and the supplier artifacts, and maven-embedder 3.9.x is tied to resolver 1.x. Revisit on a Maven 4 migration.
Stay on the -groovy-4.0 Spock variant: the project builds with Groovy 4.0.x (gradle/libs.versions.toml).
@types/vscode must not exceed the minor of engines.vscode in editors/code/package.json (^1.103.0); bump both together.
infra/runner (self-hosted runner) is disabled/dormant; do not propose updates there.
